after.zh: Softmax 将多个分数转换成总和为 1 的权重。分数之间的差决定权重的比例；相同的分数得到相同的权重。同一方法也适用于三个或更多分数。
after.en: Softmax turns scores into weights that sum to 1. Differences between scores determine the ratios of the weights; equal scores receive equal weights. The same method works for three or more scores.

t.zh: 分类器判断图像属于哪一类时，通常先为每个类别输出一个分数。分数可以是负数，也不一定加起来等于 1。
t.en: A classifier usually gives each possible class a score. Scores can be negative and do not necessarily sum to 1.

t.zh: 先看只有两个类别的情况：把两个分数转换成两个非负、总和为 1 的权重，以便比较各类别。这里使用 Softmax 的规则。
t.en: Start with two classes: turn their scores into two nonnegative weights that sum to 1, so their relative support can be compared. Here we use the Softmax rule.

t.zh: 分别对两个分数取指数，再将每个结果除以两者之和。先亲手搭出这个计算，之后就可以使用 Softmax 元件。
t.en: Take the exponential of each score, then divide each result by their sum. Build this calculation first; afterwards the Softmax part becomes available.

brief.zh: 给定两个分数 A、B，输出各自的 Softmax 权重：P(A) = e^A ÷ (e^A + e^B)，P(B) = e^B ÷ (e^A + e^B)。
brief.en: Given scores A and B, output their Softmax weights: P(A) = e^A ÷ (e^A + e^B), P(B) = e^B ÷ (e^A + e^B).

hint.zh: 先分别用 exp 处理两个分数，再求和。两个权重使用同一个分母。
hint.en: Apply exp to each score, then add the results. The two weights share the same denominator.
